Subject: Packaging question: can we stack incubator credits with pilot discount?

Hi Vanessa,

Thanks again for the great demo yesterday. Quick question from our procurement/ops side: Willow runs two programs (early-stage incubator + an internal R&D sandbox) and both are eligible for Redwood promo credits. Our finance lead asked whether those credit pools can be combined/stacked against a single pilot workspace, and whether we can add a short-term seat discount for the pilot period (6 months) while still keeping the free credits intact.

If stacking isn't standard, would your team consider a one-off packaging exception? We can provide a PO and have legal review — copying Samir for visibility.

Attachments: program-overview.pdf (PDF) — internal summary of the two programs (for context).

Best,
Anna Torres
Partnerships Director
Willow Incubator
anna@willowincubator.org

From: vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com

Date: Fri, 20 Nov 2026 11:03:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Packaging question: can we stack incubator credits with pilot discount?

Hi Anna — really appreciate the context and the deck. Short answer: we can do an exception, but we need to lock down a few operational controls so it doesn't affect our promo program rules. Proposed terms below:

- Credit stacking: Allow up to 75k free-credits combined from both programs to be applied to the single pilot workspace (one-time exception).
- Pilot seat discount: 20% off list for up to 10 FTE seats for a 6-month pilot.
- Conditions: PO for committed seats, SOW to define scope, and a single invoice split (50% credits applied, 50% invoiced) to keep accounting clean.
- Validity: exception scoped to this pilot and Willow Incubator account only; not a precedent across other partners.

Ben — can finance/legal sign off on invoice split + temporary exception? Laura — I tagged you for quick approval on accounting treatment. Samir — if you need wording we can supply a short amendment to the standard MSA.

I can draft the SOW and send a DocuSign link once internal signoffs are done. HubSpot: I logged WIL-2026-045 and attached the pricing grid for the pilot.

Attachments: pricing_grid_willow.xlsx (XLSX) — draft pilot pricing table.

Thanks —
Vanessa Ortiz

Vanessa — quick internal note. I'm good with the 75k combined credit carveout if we add these guardrails:

1) Credits expire 90 days after pilot end unless converted to a paid committed seat agreement.
2) Promo stacking flag set on the account in billing to avoid double-counting for future promos.
3) Any usage beyond 75k falls back to standard pay-as-you-go rates (no retroactive billing adjustments).

Also recommend a one-time 5% non-refundable onboarding fee to cover support during the pilot — helps protect against churn. Laura, can you confirm this is okay from an accounting/recognition standpoint? If yes, send me the OK and I'll greenlight the SOW draft.

Best,
Ben Carter
Senior Strategic Accounts
Redwood Inference

Vanessa — this looks workable. A couple quick clarifications from our side:

- The 75k cap is fine. Can you confirm whether the credits must be consumed sequentially (incubator credits first) or can they be used interchangeably?
- On the 5% onboarding fee: acceptable, as long as it's invoiced with the first month and is refundable only for force majeure.
- Samir will review the amendment wording — our legal team prefers concise amendments versus long MSAs.

We can sign the amendment via DocuSign. I'll need the SOW + invoice split to present to our finance team. Could you also split the DocuSign so our COO signs first and then the legal team? That order would speed the process.

Thanks,
Anna
